# <center> Official Resource Pack for TDR IV </center>

<center> 1.21.1 </center>

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8d631c11b0f8cc76e266f0bb47348ca0f6a9288.png)

### <center> Why this Resource Pack in particular? </center>

This Resource Pack was created specifically for the **Time DoctoR’s — TDR** server (`IP: mc.timedoctorrb.ru`) and it customizes Minecraft's main menu to make you feel part of our server from the very first second!

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8d631c11b0f8cc76e266f0bb47348ca0f6a9288.png)

### <center> What it changes: </center>

- 🌅 **Background updates:** A unique main menu background that will be updated regularly to reflect server progress and seasons.
- ✨ **A custom title:** Instead of "Minecraft" = "TDR".
- 💬 **Splash-free:** A clean, splash-free menu (all floating text is removed).

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8d631c11b0f8cc76e266f0bb47348ca0f6a9288.png)

### Our Promise:
This is a living pack! We will evolve it based on player feedback and regularly refresh the background to match major server updates.

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8d631c11b0f8cc76e266f0bb47348ca0f6a9288.png)

### Installation:

1. Download the resource pack.

2. Place it in your .minecraft/resourcepacks folder.

3. Select it in-game and fully restart your client.

![1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a8d631c11b0f8cc76e266f0bb47348ca0f6a9288.png)

### <center> Immerse yourself in TDR from the very first second! </center>
